speaker: Doctor
text:
Please describe the pain in your legs; is it worse when you walk or when you try to stand up? 

Also, have you noticed any bone tenderness or swelling in those areas?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Leukemia (likely ALL). Given the classic presentation of prolonged fatigue, easy bruising, fever, and severe bone pain in a 4-year-old, I am requesting immediate results for a Complete Blood Count (CBC) with differential and a Peripheral Blood Smear. REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential.
